title: docs(adr): ADR-0113 "Author-time fence" still says every formula read warns; add a note for the narrowed visibleWhen warning once #35190 lands
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filing gate: **(c) a residual a card's review names** — out-of-scope item reported by area b1-A from #35190 (draft PR #35475, os-dev-report 7007181589). Lands after PR #35475 merges; until then the ADR text still matches main.

## Gap
- #35190 narrows the required-field formula `visibleWhen` warning (lint and Studio) to formulas the author-time check cannot evaluate, instead of warning on any formula read.
- ADR-0113's "Author-time fence" section still states that any formula read warns. After #35475 a reader of the ADR (agents included) would expect a warning the platform no longer gives.

## Scope
- One append-only dated note under ADR-0113 "Author-time fence" naming the narrowed criterion and pointing at #35190 / PR #35475. ⛔ No rewrite of the original decision text.
- Check whether `skills/**` quotes the same sentence; fix the quote in the same PR if it does.

## Reader
`domain:skills` (governed text: `docs/adr/**`, Tier per the path fork). Suggested grade: p3 (documentation following a landed implementation).
